# Archive — woodworking-for-profit intake (observed 2026-06-22, banked 2026-09-09)

Raw dataset from the Hank Hardwood / Dale-for-profit ideation session: 74 winning long-form titles from 14 creators plus an outliers bucket, pasted as screenshots by the operator on 2026-06-22. Views and age are as displayed that day. Tool-reported outlier badges and VPH figures were shown on some screenshots and were **deliberately dropped** (core `framework.md` §5 — views only). Loaded in triage and mining sessions only; the distilled version lives in `reference-titles.md` §6.

Channel normals were not captured — performance below is read as raw ecosystem views. "Cropped" = the screenshot cut the figure off.
